calls.reason: The only study on industry-led coverage is from 2018, before the period. The 2024 Ryazanov paper shows ChatGPT absent from 25–50% of articles but doesn't count OpenAI mentions, so neither part is clearly settled.
Partly opinion ('I think'). The only evidence is OpenAI saying Deep Research is compute intensive; there is no product-level revenue or cost data.
Calling the valuation 'primarily' hype is a judgement. CNBC's report and Lightspeed's later thesis don't show how investors weighed promotional claims against revenue and other factors.
Anthropic's S-1 shows operating cash use rising from 2023 to 2024, which is only one comparison. There is no annual burn series for OpenAI.
Altman's Feb 12, 2025 roadmap says GPT-5 will be a system integrating o3 and that o3 won't ship standalone, and TechCrunch corroborates this. 'Mediocre' is his own opinion.
Epoch AI's ~$7B estimate is partly projected and uses assumed research amortization, so it doesn't decisively contradict ~$5B. No reconciled full-year figure is in the packet.
